title: fun. - We Are Young [V1]
description: Solo Nate Reuss mumble demo which is in a different key than release. According to Nate in an interview, "I sang into my phone what is essentially the chorus. And then I remember asking the other two guys for chord progressions. Andrew sent me this beat and a chord progression, and it had a little drop in it with, like, this note. I ended up using some of those chords for writing the verses, and I used that drop part - suddenly, I had a song." When asked if he still had this recording, Nate responded "Yeah, I think I do. I have so much of that stuff because I do it so often", and when asked to put it up on YouTube he responded, "Not gonna happen! I think I hit some bad notes on it.". Snippet played by Andrew Dost in an interview on November 30th, 2023.

title: ⭐ Eyes Closed [V2]
description: Good Ass Job era throwaway. Comprised of a looped sample from "Money (Dollar Bill Y'all)" by Jimmy Spicer and an excerpt from a live performance of Mary Jane by Rick James, layered over a distorted guitar loop. Kanye would reuse one of his verses for his part in the 2010 BET Awards G.O.O.D. music cypher and performed the other during a Kid Cudi show on December 22nd, 2009. The song was later given to Snoop Dogg and released on his 2011 album Doggumentary with only one of Kanye's verses. Noted by Low to not be releasing, before it leaked in January 2011.
